lines: Ma ra ba ghamza kusht o qaza ra bahana sakht
couplets.en: One sidelong glance killed me, and fate took the blame.

lines: Khud su-ye ma na did o haya ra bahana sakht
couplets.en: The beloved would not look my way and called it modesty.

lines: Ma ra ba ghamza kusht o qaza ra bahana sakht
couplets.en: One sidelong glance killed me, and fate took the blame.

lines: Zahid na dasht tab-e jamal-e pari-rukhan
couplets.en: The ascetic could not bear the beauty of those fairy faces.

lines: Zahid na dasht tab-e jamal-e pari-rukhan
couplets.en: The ascetic could not bear the beauty of those fairy faces.

lines: Kunji girift o yad-e Khuda ra bahana sakht
couplets.en: He withdrew to a corner, saying he wished to remember God.

lines: Raftam ba masjid ke bebinam jamal-e dost
couplets.en: I went to the mosque hoping to see my beloved's face.

lines: Raftam ba masjid ke bebinam jamal-e dost
couplets.en: I went to the mosque hoping to see my beloved's face.

lines: Dasti ba ru kashid o dua ra bahana sakht
couplets.en: The beloved drew a hand across the face, as though in prayer.

lines: Dasti ba dosh-e ghair nihad az rah-e karam
couplets.en: The beloved kindly rested a hand on another's shoulder.

lines: Dasti ba dosh-e ghair nihad az rah-e karam
couplets.en: The beloved kindly rested a hand on another's shoulder.

lines: Ma ra chu did laghzish-e pa ra bahana sakht
couplets.en: On seeing me, the beloved said it was only a slip of the foot.
